items.text: Hello Planimal trainers, as our promise to keep you all updated, we've just launched a small update with various fixes. In addition to this, the demo on our steam page has been updated to reflect the fixes from QOL 1 & 2.
Switch has also been brought up to parity, with the PC version which you can read about here.

Hi everyone,
First off, as we have said numerous times now, thank you for the feedback that’s been shared since the beta through to launch and beyond, it shapes the way we develop and build the game.

After the post-launch flurry of updates, things have been a little quieter, which isn’t ideal. We really want to provide you with meaningful updates which we couldn't do until the initial bug fixing patches were completed and work progressed on the more quality of life focused update which was promised.

We’re a small team but we’re passionate about what we do and giving you an enjoyable gaming experience is really what we sign up for by coming to work in the games industry. We know there have been frustrations out there and despite things being quieter on the communication front, we’ve certainly tried to give every player a voice, hear your concerns and take them to heart. We don’t want to overpromise on something until we’re sure of it, so a lot of Monster Harvest has been behind the scenes work lately.
With that said, we’re in a position now to share details on the next updates for Monster Harvest! These will come in the form of 2 updates, for all platforms.
Update 1
Coming early in the new year! It will land on PC first, followed by consoles which require some additional porting and certification before we can get them out to you.
Massive UI overhaul
Menus all optimized and some redesigned
Text popups for pickups and items
Rescaled multiple text instance
Controller support improvements
Improving controls & menu navigation when using a controller
Crop signposting
Crops will now more clearly tell you when they are ready to harvest
A map of Planimal Point is now available
See where you stand with the resident of Planimal Point with a new relationship tracker
Clearer stamina and exp usage and caps
General game & economy balancing

Lots of minor bug fixes: Then there will be another update a little further along the new year which will bring big changes to the Planimal System, customisation & in-game story!: We’ll share more details on that soon, but we wanted to give you an overview of what is being worked on.: Thank you for playing Monster Harvest and stay tuned for more in the new year, happy holidays from us all at Merge Games & Maple Powered Games!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363350/Monster_Harvest/
Hey everyone,
We've been hard at work on the latest hotfix and we're pleased to share that hotfix #8 is now live!
Hotfix 8 updates
Fixed issue with mount blocker.
Fixed an issue where players sometimes could not interact with the pause menu using mouse & keyboard.
Fixed an issue where slimes sometimes were not able to be sold or trashed.
Feed hopper will now refill correctly when upgrading the barn interior.
Fixed an issue with being able to place an infinite amount of certain objects on top of one another.
Fixed an issue where the Mutanko statue was unable to be picked up once placed.
Fixed an issue with mounts remaining active whilst in the dungeon.
Fixed an issue that sometimes caused players to clip into the Saloon and get stuck.
Correctly applied the relationship discount to item upgrades.
Fixed an issue where the demo end screen would occasionally show upon loading your save game.
Settings screen correctly working in the pause menu.
Adjusted controller UI input sensitivity.
Various NPC & merchant fixes.
Some small fixes made to livestock interaction and harvesting.
Fixed an issue where plants would sometimes advance their growth stage upon loading a save file.
Correctly show control diagrams for mouse/keyboard, Xbox controller or PlayStation controller.

Hi everyone,

notes.title: These are the steps to take to share your game data

items.text: Open any windows explorer window and paste the following into the search bar %appdata%/../LocalLow/Maple Powered Games
You will see a folder called Monster harvest
Right-click and select ‘zip’ or utilise whatever zipping tool you use.
Email the zipped folder to us at techsupport@mergegames.com - Please put in the email title - ‘Monster Harvest Game Data’

Hi everyone,
Sorry for the slower updates this week, a few things took a bit longer in testing but we are happy to share Hotfix 4 and have addressed a few of the bigger bugs that are outstanding.
Hotfix #4 updates
Fixed an issue with Planimals disappearing
The bunker should now function correctly
Fixed an issue with crops not growing in the dark season
Fixed a bug where a floor tile can appear on your head when entering the bunker.
Per our last update, we're continuing to work on fixing key bugs and addressing balancing and quality of life issues raised by players.

It's been a rocky start, but we're hopeful that the experience is much improved with these patches and we look forward to talking with you all about more fun content updates and the future of Monster Harvest.
皆さん、こんにちは。
まずは、モンスター・ハーベストをプレイするうえで、発生したバグについてお詫び申し上げます。私たちは、この問題を解決するためのアップデートの提供に最善を尽くしています。
過去一週間にわたって、Steamにて3つのホットフィックスを配信し、いくつかのバグやQoLアップデートを加えました。
ホットフィックス #1 アップデート：
• ローカライズの変更
• クイーンスライムスポーンの問題を修正
• ハイブリッド植物がきちんと育つようになりました
• 畜舎を出るときのの干し草を修正
• 水の衝突の問題を修正
• セーブに関する問題を修正しました。多くのプレイヤーが経験していた問題が解決することを願っています。
ホットフィックス #2 アップデート：
• 畜舎が消える問題を修正
• 乗り物がクローン化する問題を修正
• スライムと工具をアップグレードするとNPCとのやりとりができなくなる問題を修正
• 家畜小屋ができない問題を修正
ホットフィックス #3 アップデート：
• Escキーでメニューから戻る機能を実装
• 家畜生産、材料改良、料理の販売価格など、プレイヤーに正しく利益をもたらすように修正
• 誤って工具を振ってしまい、標的に当たらなかった場合、スタミナを消費しなくなった
• すべてのアイテムに販売価格を表示
• 釣り竿やアップグレード、じょうろ使用時のスタミナ消費量のバランスを変更
さらに多くの修正に対応しており、今後も可能な限り頻繁にホットフィックスを配信していきます。
モンスター・ハーベストは、長期的なサポートを計画しています。バグを修正した後、楽しいコンテンツをたくさんお届けできることを楽しみにしています。
どの種類のコンソールでも、パッチ提供のプロセスはPCと異なります。そのため、場合によっては数週間もの時間がかかってしまうことがあります。現在、コンソール用のパッチに取り組んでおり、できる限り早くお届けできるよう努力しております。
これらのアップデートに取り組んでいますので、引き続きご協力をお願い致します。
Merge Gamesチーム一同より

Localisation changes

You will see a folder called Monster harvest
Right-click and select ‘zip’ or utilise whatever zipping tool you use.
Email the zipped folder to us at techsupport@mergegames.com - Please put in the email title - ‘Monster Harvest Game Data’
Any of the following information would be useful if you are able to recall any of it alongside your data.
Number of planimals
Number of crops
Day
Season
Barn and upgrades to the barn
Stable and upgrades to stable
Number of mounts
Number of livestock
Items in chests
We hope this resolves a number of issues for many players, please do keep your bug reports and feedback coming.
